articles.summary: This post is about how to think through whether a sabbatical is right for you, when you should take one, and what taking your sabbatical at RC can offer you.
articles.title: Sabbaticals for the rest of us

articles.summary: We chatted with two alums who came to RC for a professional sabbatical about what they wanted out of the retreat, how their batches actually unfolded, and the impact it’s had on their lives since then.
articles.title: Surprise and self-discovery: Victoria and Jordan’s sabbaticals at RC
